classifications.rationale: The President transmits a statutorily required report to congressional leaders; this is a report to Congress and does not itself govern agencies or alter legal rights.
classifications.evidence: I hereby transmit the first annual report

classifications.rationale: The President recounts his direction to executive departments and agencies to implement statutory requirements; the agencies are the actors, implementation is mandatory, and any legal consequences arise through their administration of the Act rather than from this reporting passage itself.
classifications.evidence: I directed all affected executive departments and agencies to take all steps necessary, consistent with the Constitution, to implement the requirements of the Act.

classifications.rationale: The President reports factual findings, explains his recommendation against additional sanctions, and urges diplomatic efforts; it neither directs an agency to produce a specified legal outcome nor itself changes legal rights or duties.
classifications.evidence: My conclusion is that the imposition of additional economic sanctions at this time would not be helpful
